BEYOND THE SERVER GRID · load balancers, Kubernetes, dedicated servers, Object Storage
plans for a human · the tool changes nothing
NodePort of shop/debug is open to the Internet on 1 node(s)
Restrict the node-port range (30000-32767) in the Cloud Firewall to the load balancer's private network; use the LB's private targets.
Dedicated server has no active Robot firewall
Enable the Robot firewall with a default-discard template and explicit accepts.
Close public exposure: Kubernetes NodePort range reachable from the public internet
Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rule in IaC or restrict it to known sources; then confirm the service is unreachable from outside.
no pill = no public ingress besides WireGuard/ICMP
